what_this_file_is: Every Rust crate inside src-tauri's release binary quackoscope.exe, with the SPDX expression the crate declares in its own Cargo.toml and the licence files its published source carries.
do_not_edit_by_hand: Regenerate it with the command above. stage-host-and-opendaq-runtime-into-the-installer-payload.mjs checks cargo_lock_sha256 against src-tauri/Cargo.lock and refuses to stage when they disagree.
